summary: TE-T05 done: end-0-cowork composite shipped. B2 split out (not bundled) + 1 non-blocking out-of-zone fence flag.

items.what: Dedup .claude/skills/cowork-boundary/SKILL.md (29L) vs .claude/skills/cowork-error-boundary/SKILL.md (78L) — two overlapping boundary files both loaded every cowork cycle. Overlap confirmed live: cowork-boundary's on_error line + forbidden_outputs partially duplicate cowork-error-boundary's more detailed Error Boundary / FORBIDDEN sections; each file also carries unique content (cowork-boundary: KLFL; cowork-error-boundary: Memory-as-Truth Prohibition, MCP Call Pattern, BUG Telegram Dedup) that must survive any merge.
why_split_not_bundled: File pair is unrelated to the end-of-cycle chain TE-T05 actually merged (different call graph, different consumers) — BA's own spec (docs/handoffs/TE-T05-BA-spec.md B2) flagged it as 'unrelated scope riding along in the same row', not part of FR-1..5.

A correct dedup needs its own full consumer grep across every cowork flow file (which flows call cowork-boundary vs cowork-error-boundary vs both) before any merge is safe — the same class of diligence FR-4 needed for the 29-consumer cowork-end-cycle repoint. Coupling two independent consumer-audits into one diff raises review surface exactly when TE-T05's own diff needs focused scrutiny on the notebook-write pointer-vs-copy boundary (3 hardened invariants live there: AC-2a immutability, AC-5 line-cap, c<NNN> UUID-provenance).
Savings disparity: ~20k tok/day (dedup) vs ~130-165k tok/day (TE-T05 main deliverable) — small side benefit not worth the coupled blast-radius increase on a QA-gated composite-skill commit.

Precedent inside this same row: FR-7 already carved the DEPRECATED append-session-record deletion OUT of TE-T05 for the identical reason (separately-scoped row UC-MDH-P2 owns it) — same principle applied here.
items.recommendation: Mint a new P2/P3 backlog row (any sprint) for the cowork-boundary/cowork-error-boundary dedup. Artifact-class routing (po_routing_ruling_20260721) applies — deliverable is .claude/skills/**/SKILL.md, so owner/next_agent = agent-father, no ba->architect->pm relay needed, same as TE-T05 itself.

items.what: scripts/audits/notebook-class-fence.sh:34-35 SCAN_SET greps docs/agents/*/flow/ for the literal pattern "cowork-end-cycle\|notebook-write" to build FENCE-A's agent scan set. TE-T05 repointed all 29 live consumers from cowork-end-cycle/SKILL.md to end-0-cowork/SKILL.md and deleted cowork-end-cycle/SKILL.md outright (0 remaining live consumers). Any agent whose flow file matched ONLY via the old "cowork-end-cycle" token (not also via a literal "notebook-write" string elsewhere in the same file) now silently drops out of SCAN_SET — degrades FENCE-A into an under-scan / false-green, not a hard break (script still runs, just checks fewer agents than before).
items.fix: Update the grep pattern on notebook-class-fence.sh:35 from "cowork-end-cycle\|notebook-write" to "end-0-cowork\|notebook-write".
